title: Performance Setup
subtitle: Quick setup — goals land in your Goals tab automatically
welcome:
A few quick questions for your **performance** area.

Your answers become **Goals** you can track in the sidebar.
completeMessage: You're set. Check **Goals** for what you entered — log sessions when you're ready.

steps.question: What's one goal you're working toward in this area?
steps.placeholder: e.g. Make varsity, Perform at spring recital

steps.question: Any cardio or running target? Optional — type **skip** if not relevant.
steps.placeholder: e.g. Run a 5K under 25 min, 15 miles per week

steps.question: Do you lift weights or work out in the gym?
options: Yes, I work out in the gym
